**The [[Syrian Arab Army]] launches a ground offensive against [[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham|HTS]] and [[National Front for Liberation|NFL]]-held areas in northern [[Hama]] and southern [[Idlib]], after six days of intensive airstrikes on the region. ;Health and environment
*The United Nations [[Global Assessment Report on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services]] reports that, due to human activity, the Earth's [[biodiversity]] has suffered a catastrophic decline that is unprecedented in [[World history (field)|human history]]. ;International relations
*[[China–United States trade war]], [[China–United States relations]]
**Chinese stocks are down, falling more than 5 percent as of midday, following [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s threats to raise tariffs against Chinese-made goods on Sunday. The current negotiations for a new deal between the two countries, originally planned for Wednesday, are now in question. U.S. stock [[Futures exchange|futures]] fell sharply as well. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48173020 (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/06/business/global-markets-trade-trump.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-05-05/-tariff-man-is-back-stock-futures-sink-on-trump-trade-tweets (Bloomberg)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Turkish local elections]], [[March 2019 Istanbul mayoral election|2019 Istanbul mayoral election]]
** After a narrow victory of Turkey's main opposition party [[Cumhuriyet Halk Partisi|CHP]] against [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]]'s [[Justice and Development Party (Turkey)|AKP]] in Istanbul's mayoral election last month, Turkey’s [[Supreme Electoral Council (Turkey)|Supreme Electoral Council]] annulled the results and ordered a rerun of the election for the mayor of Istanbul. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/06/world/europe/turkey-istanbul-mayor-election.html (''The New York Times'')]

*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
** The [[Attorney General of Guatemala|Attorney General]] and the [[International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala]] (CICIG) present a new case of corruption involving the current Economy Minister Acisclo Valladares Urruela, the presidential candidate Estuardo Galdámez of the ruling party [[National Convergence Front]] and seven deputies. They also request the revocation of the immunity of these politicians to proceed with their arrest. Galdámez is the sixth presidential candidate who has a process for possible acts of corruption. [https://elperiodico.com.gt/nacion/2019/05/06/mp-y-cicig-presentan-antejuicio-contra-siete-diputados-y-el-ministro-de-economia/ (''elPeriódico de Guatemala'')]
